notes: JevBench v1.6.1 (Benchmark Heaven; board v1.7.12; retrieved 2026-10-06, some pages stamped 2026-10-07): an independent board where the operator runs every row. Composite = harmonic mean of intelligence, calibration, speed and cost axes under "Jev-class" cost/latency caps, so a model can be #1 on capability and low on composite (Perplexity Decider v1.1: capability 82.8, composite 20.6) because open-weight cost is priced from a base-model reference. Latency: hosted API rows are measured from a server in Germany; open-weight rows are measured on the evaluator GPU and then ADJUSTED (x2 + 0.15 s assumption). Both raw and adjusted are stored under different metric ids. The OpenAI Decisions row is a 600-item A5 U P re-run equated to the 1,500-item scale. SCOPE CUT: the board lists 106 systems; stored here are (a) every hosted-API row that maps to a registry model or a general-LLM baseline, and (b) the open-weight rows of models in this registry (Clef, Clef-flash, Perplexity v1.1, Kev 27B, Jebadiah, Eikos, JPT-35B-A3B, Decision 2.0 Vega, decider-2b/4b/35b, Winnow-12B, Torchcast 27B, Quyet Large, JADE, JEV-27B, lev, Laya, metask, deck-31B, GEV-26B, Jev-Omni, decider chat Gemma-4-31B, Nimble v3). Not stored: ~70 hobbyist open-weight rebuilds, raw-logit controls, rerankers, three kev research-preview sizes, author-hosted demos and the classifier.dev wrapper that serves Jev. Scores are not comparable across JevBench versions; the GitHub README (v1.4.2.2, Imajev-4B #1) is stale.

claims.statement: JevBench hosted-API table: OpenAI Decisions (gpt-6-luna) composite 62.5 (A5 U P, 600 items equated; 95% interval 51.6-64.6), capability 73.5, $0.0517 per 1,000 decisions, 0.30 s p50; Jev 1.13.0 composite 71.5, capability 77.1, $0.0323, 0.24 s. Hosted-API table ranks: Sage 1.3.0 74.0 (rank 1), Liquid d1 73.0 (rank 2), Jev 71.5 (rank 3).

Capability vs composite split: Perplexity Decider v1.1 is rank 1 by capability (82.8) but composite rank 41 (20.6); Clef capability 75.3 (composite rank 53, 16.8; raw p50 0.213 s, adjusted 0.576 s, $0.2492 per 1,000 decisions); Clef-flash capability 63.8 (composite rank 24, 36.6; raw 0.103 s, adjusted 0.356 s). Open-weight cost is priced from a base-model reference, not tariffs.
claims.implication: Do not read the composite as a quality ranking of self-hosted 27B models; use capability for quality and check the cost basis.
